verdict.rationale: Groq's LoRA docs say users can upload their existing LoRA adapters and run inference on them on Groq infrastructure, which meets the story's 'or LoRA adapters' path. The evidence is limited to short first-party statements and gives no detail on how the feature works in practice. Missing for 10: support for uploading full custom model weights, documentation of the upload workflow and supported base models, independent or hands-on corroboration of LoRA serving.
